jobs.occupation: Junior Solution Manager for Solar BESS (m/f/d) – Graduate Program (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
About Huawei

Huawei is a leading global provider of information and communications technology (ICT) infrastructure and smart devices. With integrated solutions across four key domains – telecom networks, IT, smart devices, and cloud services – we are committed to bringing digital to every person, home and organization for a fully connected, intelligent world.

At Huawei, innovation focuses on customer needs. We invest heavily in basic research, concentrating on technological breakthroughs that drive the world forward. With approximately 208,000 employees, we operate in more than 170 countries and regions.

Huawei's end-to-end portfolio of products, solutions and services are both competitive and secure. Through open collaboration with ecosystem partners, we create lasting value for our customers, working to empower people, enrich home life, and inspire innovation in organizations of all shapes and sizes.

Job Title:

Junior Solution Manager for Solar BESS (m/f/d) – Graduate Program

Job Location:

Düsseldorf or Munich, Germany

Main Responsibilities:

As a Junior Solution Manager in our Smart PV Business, you will join the Digital Power Business Group and contribute to delivering innovative digital and power electronics solutions that accelerate the transition toward a smarter, greener energy future. In this role you will handle following tasks:

- Support the evaluation of Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) solutions for different application scenarios such as utility-scale projects
- Assist with technical solution design by analyzing customer requirements, preparing technical assessments and supporting project development activities
- Support customer and partner engagement by preparing technical presentations and documentation, and participating in technical discussions
- Engage closely with customers to understand their requirements and technical challenges, recommend suitable solutions from our product portfolio under the guidance of senior team members, and translate customer feedback into input for future product development
- Participate in industry exhibitions, technical workshops and customer events to support technical communication

Requirements:

- Recent graduate student with Bachelor/Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering with focus on Power Engineering or related technical discipline
- First touch points and passion for renewable energies including but not limited to utility-scale solar, PV, BESS will be an advantage
- Good communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently on defined tasks and effectively collaborate with customers, partners and internal teams

Language requirements:

- Fluency in English and German (C1-C2 level) is mandatory

Huawei's Fresh Graduate Program:

- We offer you an exciting professional career in one of the leading and fastest growing multinational telecommunication companies;
- Personal Development is ensured through training and workshop opportunities in the first 6 months;
- Firsthand experience in customer engagement and new technology innovation;
- Challenging and diverse assignments that enable you to continuously develop your personal and professional strengths;
- Mentor/Buddy Program: A mentor that will guide you through both business and intercultural development;
- After onboarding, internal networking activities with other fresh Graduates take place on a regular basis.

Important: To be considered for this role, applicants must be eligible to work and live in the job location.

Privacy Statement:

We are committed to protecting your privacy by following the applicable data protection legislation. By applying to this position at Huawei, you acknowledge that you have read and understood the Huawei Recruitment Privacy Statement containing information on how we process your data. Please note that your data will be treated confidentially and securely.

You can contact us by clicking here to get information about Huawei, contact Huawei’s DPO, submit any requests regarding your personal data, exercise your privacy rights, or submit any questions, comments, or suggestions related to the Privacy Statement.

jobs.occupation: Corporate Lending: Risk Control & Oversight Officer (m/f/d) (Risk-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Lloyds Bank GmbH and its brands Bank of Scotland and Lloyds Bank have won over 1 million satisfied customers in recent years. And this thanks to convincing products and, above all, our committed colleagues who want to achieve the best for our customers every day with new ideas, challenges and joy. In order to continue writing our success story, we are looking for the right reinforcement for our teams, because all our ambitious goals would be unattainable without teamwork. We also welcome career changers.

For our office in Berlin Mitte we are looking for a Corporate Lending: Risk Control & Oversight Officer (m/f/d).

Your tasks:

- Monitor policy adherence, control performance, key risk indicators, data quality, actions, and supplier performance across the corporate lending lifecycle.
- Perform thematic oversight reviews, document findings, track remediation, and provide constructive challenge where required.
- Prepare oversight reports, dashboards, committee materials, and service reviews, highlighting recurring themes and emerging risks.
- Support new lending products and material changes by developing controls, reporting, data quality checks, workflows, and implementation tracking.
- Identify opportunities to improve and automate governance, monitoring, reporting, and evidence collection in collaboration with internal stakeholders and specialist providers.

Your knowledge/experience:

- Relevant professional experience in risk management, controls, audit, compliance, governance, credit risk, data, transformation, or a related banking function.
- Experience supporting controls, action tracking, oversight reporting, committee materials, service reviews, or risk documentation.
- Experience with data analytics, reporting, workflow automation, or low-code tools such as Power BI, Power Automate, Python, SQL, Databricks, Alteryx, or similar, together with an interest in the responsible use of AI.
- Interest in developing deeper knowledge of corporate lending and credit risk; experience in an ECB-supervised banking environment is an advantage.
- Ability to engage constructively with stakeholders across the first and second lines, Group, Finance, IT, Data, and senior management.
- Fluency in English is required; German and/or Dutch is an advantage.

We offer:

- An international team with colleagues from more than 50 different countries
- Social benefits such as a company pension scheme and capital formation contributions
- 30 days holiday as well as 24 and 31 December as non-working days
- Employee Assistance Programme – personal 24/7 helpline for all employees
- Various possibilities for flexible working, i.a. various part-time models, flexitime
- Extensive, very flexible home office arrangements
- Possibility to work from other EU countries for up to 30 days per year
- Additional benefits such as sports activities, free fruit, nuts and drinks
- Employer contributions to BVG job ticket and a Lease a bike programme
- An informal corporate culture - without dress code and ‘Sie’.
- An excellent learning culture and opportunity to improve your professional competencies
- Easily accessible city centre offices, in the vicinity of many shops and restaurants to which you receive a discount

We look forward to receiving your complete application (max. 3 MB) with a CV, references, salary expectations and earliest possible start date in English. Please send your application by e-mail only with the subject "Corporate Lending: Risk Control & Oversight Officer (m/f/d)" to the following e-mail address: recruitment@lloydsbank.de (https://mailto:recruitment@lloydsbank.de)

jobs.occupation: Experienced Red Teamer / Pentester - Cybersecurity Audit (m/f/d) - DISW (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
Start your cyber career with us!
As part of the global Cybersecurity Assurance function, we help Siemens to achieve their goals by providing objective, factual and independent assurance to the Siemens Managing Board and Audit Committee. As a business partner to Siemens executive management, we leverage our expertise in a wide range of topics to create an impact that drives change. We offer a vibrant and inclusive environment which ensures a variety of perspectives and enables big picture thinking.
To deliver on our vision of being pioneers in assurance and a talent incubator for Siemens, we offer a unique Grow and Development Model. We believe in the concept of lifelong learning and therefore encourage our people towards a mindset where continuous upskilling and reskilling becomes a natural part of our career. We invest in our expertise and therefore provide continuous career coaching, trainings and mentoring, all whilst working with top Siemens business leaders on multiple high-profile projects around the world.
Our Cybersecurity team provides core assurance over the cybersecurity health of the company which includes IT infrastructures, product security, software development and cloud environments. We are on the lookout for people with a great skillset, an international mindset and new ideas who understand Siemens businesses and how Cybersecurity helps enable and increase market value. Are you one of them?
To discover more about the global Siemens assurance function click here (https://assets.new.siemens.com/siemens/assets/api/uuid:832d2c5d-e30c-4163-a1be-9fa3d67f645b/controlling-and-finance-assurance-info-for-applicants.pdf) .
What part will you play?

- As valuable member of the assurance team you will be responsible for conducting and driving Cybersecurity assessments across the entire Siemens landscape, including products, services, IT-systems, and software development centers. During this process you will plan and perform ethical hacking activities, design attack scenarios for state-of-the-art technologies and highlight important observations to translate technical findings into management information so that they can take effective actions. - Apply advanced hacking principles and red team methodologies, tools and techniques to mimic real-world threat behaviors faced by the Siemens’s digital environment, e.g. cloud applications, on-premise infrastructure, digital products and services.- You work closely with cybersecurity experts from multiple industries to improve their solutions by tackling the root cause of the issues and find innovative solutions to modern challenges.- You independently conduct research on latest developments in cybersecurity technologies and threats and understand how this is impacting and changing the Siemens’ environment.

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:

- Strong academic history (Bachelor degree) in IT, Computer Science or other related fields; certifications such as GIAC GPEN, OSCP, OSWE, CRTO, CREST, etc. are a plus. - Good scripting and programming skills and experience with languages such as Bash, Python, Powershell, and C++ / C#.- At least 5+ years of professional full-time working experience within Siemens or a related industry in penetration testing / red teaming with a proven record of continuous career development.- Demonstrated affinity to learn about the latest trends in cybersecurity and keep up to date in a continuously challenging environment.- You have solid experience with one or more of the following aspects of penetration testing / red teaming: application and software security, EDR and antivirus evasion, C2 setup, automation and scaling of security testing, Active Directory attacks, etc.- Demonstrated experience in capture the flag (CTFs) events, bug hunting or vulnerability research (CVEs) is a plus.- Experience with leveraging and integrating AI into day-to-day work is considered an advantage.- Fluent in English. German or other languages are a plus.- You demonstrate an international mindset and are open to international travel, and working in a diverse team

jobs.description:
The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

The DKFZ is a place where the brightest minds pursue bold ideas and seek answers to pioneering scientific questions through collaboration, innovation, and exploration across many disciplines. We provide a dynamic environment which empowers excellence with state-of-the-art technologies, cutting edge infrastructure, and a global scientific network. 

Contribute your knowledge, vision, and dedication to create a space where scientific discovery in cancer research is transformed into benefits for human health.

For our Junior Research Group Pediatric Immuno-Oncology (led by Dr. Dr. Franziska Blaeschke) we are seeking, starting in January 2027, a PhD Student - Immunotherapy/Optical CRISPR Screens/Spatial Transcriptomics.

Our group uses advanced genetic engineering and high-throughput CRISPR screens to improve CAR- and TCR-based immunotherapies. This project explores how highly effective anti-tumor immune cells can be identified and enhanced to better fight cancer. By combining functional screening (e.g., genome-wide CRISPR screens), cutting-edge cell engineering (e.g., AAV-based knockins, base editing), and innovative imaging and sequencing technologies (e.g., NIS-seq, spatial transcriptomics/proteomics), we aim to uncover key features of the most powerful anti-tumor T cells (“elite” immune cells) and translate these insights into next-generation immunotherapies.
The work will include a large variety of experimental methods and models (in vitro and in vivo), in close collaboration with the groups of Prof. Dr. Adelheid Cerwenka (Department of Immunobiochemistry, Medical Faculty Mannheim of Heidelberg University), Prof. Dr. Joachim Spatz (Department of Cellular Biophysics, Max Planck Institute), Prof. Dr. Nina Papavasiliou (Division of Immune Diversity, DKFZ), Prof. Dr. Michael Platten (Clinical Cooperation Unit Neuroimmunology and Brain Tumor Immunology at DKFZ and Department of Neurology at the University Medical Center Mannheim), and Dr. Vibor Laketa (Infectious Diseases Imaging Platform, UKHD). Together, the project seeks to define and build next-generation immune cells with enhanced therapeutic potential.

Your Tasks

- Establishing new experimental protocols and optimizing technologies (e.g., NIS-seq, spatial CRISPR screens)
- Working on computational approaches to read out CRISPR screens, imaging and sequencing data (e.g., spatial transcriptomics/proteomics)
- Designing and performing complex experiments involving a large number of methods (e.g., cloning, CRISPR/Cas9, viral transduction, AAV generation, flow cytometry, microfluidics systems, next-generation sequencing, microscopy, xenograft and syngeneic models, primary cell culture, functional analyses such as cytokine release, proliferation, cytotoxicity assays etc.)
- Staying up to date with scientific literaturePresenting your research on a regular basis within the group, the DKFZ/KiTZ and externally
- Preparing grants, patents, and publications

Your Profile

- Completed studies with a diploma or master's degree in biology, bioengineering, biomedical science, biochemistry, bioinformatics, or other relevant fields

- Excellent communication skills and social competence
- Team player who is motivated to closely work with collaboration partners within the institute and beyond
- Strong laboratory and writing skills
- Willingness to lead and perform in vivo studies
- Proficiency in English (written and spoken)
- High level of enthusiasm, motivation, and responsibility
- Deep interest in planning, conducting, and analyzing experiments in a systematic and independent way
- Effective time management and organizational skills

Please submit a motivation letter (1 page) and a CV (including a publication list and contact information of two references) in one single PDF.
